Package com.neueda.leap.passwordreset

Class PasswordResetController

java.lang.Object
com.neueda.leap.passwordreset.PasswordResetController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/auth/password-reset") public class PasswordResetController extends Object
Exposes endpoints to request and confirm password resets.
